items.title: 52115_Danny Barker oral history interview
items.q: The same thing with Simmons, him and his wife. He'd send his money home just as dutiful(?) as to keep his alliance.

ctx.x: Yes, a very handsome man. A very weird thing happened. For some reason, his wife lived in New York for years, in Long Island, and he stayed in Chicago. And he used to come like once every few years and visit.
The same thing with Simmons, him and his wife. He'd send his money home just as dutiful(?) as to keep his alliance. And his wife had another man, and he had a kid...
Yeah... Russell Smith was the same. It happened to Russell Smith the same way.
